context: Issue 20260716-order-total-rounding (order grand total rounds half-down but finance expects half-up) has been picked up and a fix approach was agreed with the user. The functions the fix impacts (step 5) are: OrderService.calcGrandTotal [unit] — sums line totals and rounds the grand total via a rounding helper; the fix wires it to MathUtil.round(value) [unit] — rounds to the nearest integer using banker's rounding (half-even). The codebase also has PriceHelper.round(value) [unit] — the money-rounding helper that rounds half-up. Run the step-7 Design self-review over the agreed fix before closing the entry. define-task authors no api-test / E2E flow, so the endpoint check does not apply here.
